scope: Offline exact arithmetic replay of 170 retained layer-0 Q2 V outputs and their F16 cache words. No gate amendment.

report.scope:
Exact offline F32 replay of the pinned 170 Q2 V cache-boundary entries.

All arithmetic is integer/rational, rounded explicitly to IEEE binary32 RNE.
The native ucrtbase fmaf is a cross-check of the software arithmetic, never
the replay's implementation. No runtime, inference, Torch or GPU is invoked.

emitted_order_audit.scope: Offline emitted-arithmetic/provenance audit of the 170-entry replay; no gate amendment.
emitted_order_audit.module_provenance: ELF64 symbol-table extraction from the retained native-probe helper; same pinned static library as the retained ISA capture. Local Windows modules were not used.
emitted_order_audit.frozen_source_identity: All twelve owner/source files match the frozen ISA receipt after CRLF-to-LF normalization; old source snapshot used where current source changed.

selected_path.basis: Frozen host dispatch and MI50 RADV profile + captured shape, dtype, weight type and completed matrix-path witness. Per-inference dispatch-counter trace was not retained.
selected_path.kernel: matmul_row_q2_0_dot; one-column specialization for final token
selected_path.grouping_note: Q/K/V projections share a dispatch through projection index pi; GROUPED=true is expert grouping and is not this call.
selected_path.lane_mapping: lane l receives activation/weight group b=l; exactly one 32-value group per lane for nin=1024
selected_path.subgroup: MI50 wave64; each row is a 32-lane cluster. XOR offsets 16,8,4,2,1 never cross the row cluster.
selected_path.producer: rms_norm_rows, quant=1; scalar normalized value is stored to F32 output and used to produce its retained twin

emitted_order_audit.integer_product: Q2 fields decode independently to -1/0/+1/+2; per-block integer sums are exact, |sum| <= 2097088 < 2^24 and < 2^31.
emitted_order_audit.scale_load: SPIR-V load ushort -> UnpackHalf2x16 -> low component; retained ISA v_cvt_f32_f16.
emitted_order_audit.float_order: First round F32(weight_scale * input_scale), then F32 FMA(scale, exact F32(integer_dot), +0); descending XOR shuffles and F32 adds. Both extracted SPIR-V and retained final machine ISA confirm these distinct operations.
emitted_order_audit.input_quantization: Ordinary path only. Scale is peak * binary32 0x38000100. Reciprocal seed is 0x7ef311c3 - significand_bits, followed by four individually rounded, NoContraction Newton triples, multiplication by 32767 and Ldexp. Round codes via separate F32 input*inverse, abs+0.5, floor, sign and clamp.
emitted_order_audit.input_quantization_limit: Producer SPIR-V and frozen source are retained; its machine ISA and packed-twin readback are not. The replay establishes the composed quantization/dot output for these 170 entries, not an independent byte comparison of every intermediate twin value.
emitted_order_audit.interpretation: Closes the localized suspicion that these Q2 V half-boundary crossings require a wrongly decoded weight, wrong Q2 integer dot, wrong scale/FMA/reduction result or wrong F16 conversion. Does not prove other coordinates/operators or end-to-end correctness.

limitations: No producer machine ISA or packed-twin readback was retained. The composed outputs match, not independently captured intermediate twins.
This resolves the localized arithmetic suspicion, not the short ranking or NLL failures or full-model correctness.
